a suboptimal control method has been proposed and implemented for industrial manipulators that provides a near minimum time- fuel (NMTF), and thus enables manipulators to perform up to their maximum capabilities and efficiency.

a new concept of average dynamics and a new control method based on the average dynamics can be used to design a feedback controller for industrial manipulators with the capability of operating them nearly up to their full speed and efficiency.

the suboptimal controller can be used to control a manipulator in such a way that the time required to perform a specified task is minimized and the manipulator is operated with the least amount of energy.

, with the new control method, manipulators can be made to move at their maximum speed and use energy at a minimum.
